integrity: All-dimensional multiplicities and asymptotic laws are proved analytically in RESULT.md. An exhaustive exact enumerator checks N=3..8 only and does not establish the infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Statements concern only the canonical, integer-coordinate Loday embedding and its intrinsic Euclidean metric. The local edge-length formula and longest-edge bound are Loday's prior results. The weighted-total integer sequence matches known OEIS A000531; historical priority for the new joint distribution and sampling-law results remains provisional.
title: Exact Euclidean edge spectrum and a Dirichlet length-condensation law for Loday associahedra
